scenarioCoverage.observation: The real-file fixture records reference digest and rights mode on a valid import; missing or incompatible rights and reference reuse fail before catalog mutation.
The real-file fixture produces deterministic id, revision, dimensions, thumbnail, category, tags and file digests; invalid categories, identifiers and immutable-path conflicts are rejected.
Visual approval is bound to the exact candidate digest and human actor; a changed or mismatched digest cannot advance the state.
Release approval requires current technical QA plus the exact item and QA digests; missing or stale evidence fails without changing production.

Promotion verifies both approvals, snapshots the old catalog, copies immutable files, verifies bytes and atomically updates the manifest; conflict injection leaves the old catalog usable and supports a safe retry.
All ten active catalog entries pass the zero-chroma schema and image gate; a high-green candidate remains blocked for a digest-bound human decision and cannot be treated as approved automatically.

A single-use human request binds the reference digest and one candidate; missing, consumed or mismatched authorization fails before writes; the historical unauthorized candidate remains rejected in a digest-preserving quarantine.

boundaries.claim: This evidence refreshes the L1 machine-verifiable workflow correction against the current sealed implementation. It is not human semantic review, user research, or final product acceptance.
